question: She was a Carnatic legendary singer who sang in Europe, North America and at the United Nations General Assembly. Who was she?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **M.S. Subbulakshmi** was a renowned Carnatic singer from India, known for her exceptional vocal talent.
 
• She was the first Indian musician to perform at the United Nations General Assembly in **1966**.
 
• Subbulakshmi sang in various prestigious venues across **Europe and North America**, promoting Indian classical music worldwide.
 
• She received numerous awards and honors, including the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, in **1998**.
 
• M.S. Subbulakshmi was also known for her philanthropic efforts and contributions to various social causes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Carnatic Music:** A classical music form that originated in the southern part of India, known for its intricate rhythms and melodic structures.
 
• **Bharat Ratna:** The highest civilian award in India, awarded for exceptional service in various fields such as arts, literature, public service, and more.
 
• **United Nations General Assembly:** One of the six principal organs of the UN, where all member nations have equal representation and discuss global issues.
 
• **Philanthropy:** The act of promoting the welfare of others, typically through generous donations of money, resources, or time to charitable causes.
 
• **Legacy:** M.S. Subbulakshmi's influence on Indian classical music continues to be celebrated, and she remains an iconic figure in the world of music.
